# Check security group rules for each region for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "=== Region: $region ===" >&2 aws ec2 describe-security-groups \ --region "$region" \ --output json \ --query 'SecurityGroups[].[GroupId, GroupName, IpPermissions[?FromPort==`22` || (FromPort==null && ToPort==null)]]' > /tmp/sg_${region}.json cat /tmp/sg_${region}.json done

# Get comprehensive view of all instances with their security groups echo "=== All instances with security group details ===" >&2 for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do aws ec2 describe-instances \ --region "$region" \ --output json > /tmp/instances_full_${region}.json # Parse and display instances with their security groups jq -r '.Reservations[] | .Instances[] | "\(.InstanceId) | \(.State.Name) | Region: '$region' | PublicIP: \(.PublicIpAddress // "none") | SGs: \(.SecurityGroups | map(.GroupId) | join(", "))"' \ /tmp/instances_full_${region}.json done echo "" echo "=== Security groups allowing SSH from internet ===" >&2 for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do jq -r '.SecurityGroups[] | select(.IpPermissions[] | select(.FromPort == 22) | select(.IpRanges[]? | select(.CidrIp == "0.0.0.0/0"))) | "\(.GroupId) | \(.GroupName) | Region: '$region'"' \ /tmp/sg_${region}.json 2>/dev/null done

# Find security groups that allow SSH (port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0 echo "=== Security groups allowing SSH from internet (0.0.0.0/0) ===" >&2 echo "" for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do jq -r '.SecurityGroups[] | select(.IpPermissions[]? | select(.FromPort == 22) and (.IpRanges[]? | select(.CidrIp == "0.0.0.0/0"))) | "Region: '$region' | GroupId: \(.GroupId) | GroupName: \(.GroupName)"' \ /tmp/sg_${region}.json done echo "" echo "=== Matching instances to SSH-accessible security groups ===" >&2 # Build a list of security group IDs that allow SSH from internet SSH_ACCESSIBLE_SGs=$(for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do jq -r '.SecurityGroups[] | select(.IpPermissions[]? | select(.FromPort == 22) and (.IpRanges[]? | select(.CidrIp == "0.0.0.0/0"))) | "\(.GroupId):\(.GroupName):'$region'"' \ /tmp/sg_${region}.json done) if [ -z "$SSH_ACCESSIBLE_SGs" ]; then echo "No security groups found allowing SSH from internet" else echo "SSH-accessible security groups:" echo "$SSH_ACCESSIBLE_SGs" echo "" # Now check which instances use these groups echo "Instances using SSH-accessible security groups:" for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do jq -r '.Reservations[] | .Instances[] | select(.SecurityGroups[]? | .GroupId as $sg | "'$SSH_ACCESSIBLE_SGs'" | split("\n") | map(split(":")[0]) | index($sg) != null) | "Region: '$region' | InstanceId: \(.InstanceId) | State: \(.State.Name) | PublicIP: \(.PublicIpAddress // "none") | SecurityGroups: \(.SecurityGroups | map(.GroupId + " (" + .GroupName + ")") | join(", "))"' \ /tmp/instances_full_${region}.json done fi

# Re-fetch full security group data for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do aws ec2 describe-security-groups \ --region "$region" \ --output json > /tmp/sg_full_${region}.json done # Now find SSH-accessible groups echo "=== Security groups allowing SSH from 0.0.0.0/0 ===" >&2 for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do jq -r '.SecurityGroups[] | select(.IpPermissions[]? | select(.FromPort == 22 or .FromPort == null) | select(.IpRanges[]? | select(.CidrIp == "0.0.0.0/0"))) | "Region: '$region' | GroupId: \(.GroupId) | GroupName: \(.GroupName) | VpcId: \(.VpcId)"' \ /tmp/sg_full_${region}.json done

# Now find instances using the SSH-accessible security group echo "=== Instances using SSH-accessible security groups ===" >&2 echo "" for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do jq -r '.Reservations[] | .Instances[] | select(.SecurityGroups[]? | select(.GroupId == "sg-e09f294c535b617c7")) | "InstanceId: \(.InstanceId) State: \(.State.Name) Region: '$region' PublicIP: \(.PublicIpAddress // "NONE (not publicly accessible)") PrivateIP: \(.PrivateIpAddress // "N/A") SecurityGroups: \(.SecurityGroups | map("\(.GroupId) (\(.GroupName))") | join(", "))"' \ /tmp/instances_full_${region}.json if [ $? -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$(jq '.Reservations[] | .Instances[] | select(.SecurityGroups[]? | select(.GroupId == "sg-e09f294c535b617c7"))' /tmp/instances_full_${region}.json 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "---" fi done # Summary echo "" echo "=== SUMMARY ===" >&2 echo "" echo "Checking all instances for public accessibility..." REACHABLE_COUNT=0 for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do RESULTS=$(jq -r '.Reservations[] | .Instances[] | select(.SecurityGroups[]? | select(.GroupId == "sg-e09f294c535b617c7")) | select(.State.Name == "running") | select(.PublicIpAddress != null) | "\(.InstanceId)|\(.PublicIpAddress)|\(.PrivateIpAddress)|\(.State.Name)"' \ /tmp/instances_full_${region}.json) if [ -n "$RESULTS" ]; then while IFS='|' read -r instance_id public_ip private_ip state; do REACHABLE_COUNT=$((REACHABLE_COUNT + 1)) done <<< "$RESULTS" fi done echo "Total instances reachable via SSH from the internet: $REACHABLE_COUNT"

# Check launch templates to ensure no instances inherit SSH-accessible groups from them echo "=== Checking launch templates for SSH-accessible security groups ===" >&2 for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do aws ec2 describe-launch-templates \ --region "$region" \ --output json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.LaunchTemplates[] | .LaunchTemplateId' | while read lt_id; do if [ -n "$lt_id" ]; then aws ec2 describe-launch-template-versions \ --region "$region" \ --launch-template-id "$lt_id" \ --output json 2>/dev/null | \ jq -r '.LaunchTemplateVersions[] | select(.LaunchTemplateData.SecurityGroupIds[]? | select(. == "sg-e09f294c535b617c7")) | "Region: '$region' | TemplateId: \(.LaunchTemplateId) | LaunchTemplateName: \(.LaunchTemplateName)"' || true fi done done echo "" echo "=== Check if instances use launch templates with SSH-accessible groups ===" >&2 for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do jq -r '.Reservations[] | .Instances[] | select(.LaunchTemplate != null) | "\(.InstanceId) uses LaunchTemplate: \(.LaunchTemplate.LaunchTemplateId)"' \ /tmp/instances_full_${region}.json 2>/dev/null | while read line; do echo "Region $region: $line" done done
